findings.desc: concept-cleanup: .lattice/story/actives/B-137a/checklist.json:824 and :1745 retain a binary migrated-surface contract of shared-admission/managed versus legacy_unmanaged. The adopted registry has five statuses, including admission_only, adapter_only, and readiness_probe (packages/main/src/core/provider-process-registry.ts:442-447 and :496-505); its contract asserts legacy_unmanaged is reserved and empty (packages/main/src/tasks/provider-execution-inventory-contract.ts:88-89), as does the decision record (docs/requirements/decisions/managed-cross-provider-cli-execution.md:124-140). CHK-004 and CHK-007 therefore misstate the implemented classification and their acceptance receipts cannot prove the actual inventory invariant. Replace the binary wording with the complete taxonomy plus the empty-legacy constraint.
